status.summary: Holds the ceremonial BMF belt after a 50-45, 50-45, 50-45 decision over Max Holloway at UFC 326 (Mar 7, 2026), in which he took Holloway down in every round. No. 3 at lightweight. He was booked against Arman Tsarukyan for UFC 331 but withdrew in August 2026 after the death of his teammate Allan Nascimento (not an injury). The UFC announced on Oct 4, 2026 that he defends the BMF belt against Diego Lopes, in Lopes's lightweight debut, in the UFC 335 main event on Dec 12, 2026 in Las Vegas; still listed as of Nov 6. Pro record 37-11 with 1 no contest. Former UFC lightweight champion (2021-22).

style.summary: A submission grappler who strikes to get to the mat. He walks forward behind a long jab and right hand, wrestles in the clinch and shoots early, then hunts the back, the guillotine and the anaconda. He finishes from bad positions and scrambles, but he gets hit a lot standing and has lost five UFC fights by KO/TKO (one of them, Holloway in 2015, an injury stoppage).

moves.notes: Weights are normalized to sum to 1 within the head, body and leg groups, as the director's picker expects (fact-check, Nov 6, 2026; ratios unchanged). Target split from the decayed sums in fighters.json: of significant attempts 70% head, 20% body, 11% legs (landed 64/22/14); the lightweight league is 76/15/9. So body weapons (kicks, knees, hooks) sit above the league and leg kicks stay modest. Punches follow his recorded finishes, which are punches at distance (Chandler, Gordon, Lentz) plus the jab and right hand reported in recaps (Cageside on UFC 274). Knee and elbow stand for his clinch work: 18% of landed strikes in the clinch career and 11% decayed, against 9.5% for the league. ufcstats does not record technique, so the kick/knee split inside the body share is a judgment. Spinning: none in his record. His striking output is low (3.6 significant attempts per minute over 3 years, ground strikes included) because he shoots early, so the director should give him less time standing, not lower weights.

engine_notes.note: Submission threat far above the division: 2.6 submission attempts per 15 min career and 2.2 decayed, against 0.40 for the lightweight league; 17 of his 25 UFC wins are submissions.
Takes the fight down often: 5.7 takedown attempts per 15 min at 40% (league 4.3 at 36%), with 485 s of control per 15 min decayed (league 174).

Defense is the soft spot: opponents land 59% of significant strikes on him decayed and 63% over 3 years (league 48%). Decayed chin is 1.12 knockdowns per 100 significant head strikes absorbed (league 0.95); 6 knockdowns absorbed and 5 KO/TKO losses in 37 UFC fights (one of them, Holloway in 2015, an injury stoppage).

In five-round fights his landed rate falls to 0.67 and 0.62 of round 1 in rounds 4 and 5, but much of that is time spent controlling: at UFC 326 he held 4:30, 4:40, 4:29, 4:16 and 2:54 of control in rounds 1-5.
Age 37 at the as-of date, with his last KO loss 16 months ago (Topuria, R1).
Withdrew from a booked UFC 331 fight with Tsarukyan (Sep 2026) after a teammate's death in August, so UFC 335 comes nine months after UFC 326; the withdrawal was not injury-related.
